Landing.title: Find your next job in the Nordics using AI
Landing.description: Upload your CV once and match instantly with thousands of job postings in Sweden and Norway using intelligent semantic search.
Landing.feature_1_desc: Our AI understands all Nordic languages and maps your experiences seamlessly across borders.
Landing.feature_2_desc: Upload multiple CVs for different professional roles and select which one should be active.
Landing.feature_3_desc: You have full control over your data. Delete your account and all your history with a single click.

Profile.title: Profile Settings
Profile.description: Manage your uploaded CVs, account details, and privacy settings.
Profile.no_active_cv_desc: Select one of your CVs on the left as active, or upload a new one to show your analyzed profile here.

danger_zone.title: Danger Zone
danger_zone.description: If you delete your account, all your account data, CV profiles, match results, and login will be permanently removed in accordance with GDPR. This action cannot be undone.
danger_zone.confirm_label: Type RADERA below to confirm permanent deletion:
danger_zone.error_confirm: You must type RADERA to confirm.

Cookies.title: We value your privacy 🍪
Cookies.description: We use cookies to improve your experience, analyze traffic, and for job-seeking features. Under GDPR, you have the right to choose which cookies you approve.
Cookies.essential_desc: Required for the application to function, such as keeping you logged in and saving your preferences. These cannot be disabled.
Cookies.analytics_desc: Helps us understand how the website is used so we can improve functionality and user experience.
Cookies.marketing_desc: Used to show relevant job ads and customized content based on your preferences.
